media.label: River Oaks: an evening at the office and IPIC
media.provenance: Runtime capture of River Oaks only, from commit 7712634b4a4b73a993684541887850af6f128fa7: headless Chromium 156.0.8078.4 with Metal ANGLE (ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Unspecified Version)), recorded 2026-10-15T10:20:16.541Z by scripts/ipic-short/capture.mjs and cut by scripts/ipic-short/cut.mjs. The default (legacy) office layout, synthetic fixture identities, an idle IPIC screen. No external images, music, voices, generated footage or new likenesses; characters appear as committed at that revision. Characters: Jevica is preview/public/assets/characters/jevica.glb (sha256 722b96e2…, CC0-1.0, MakeHuman system assets, marked fictional_generic_appearance) in the committed Jevica costume; the seated friend and the IPIC staff are the committed CC0 resident avatars. Street geometry is derived from OpenStreetMap; the game's "© OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL · Artistic interpretation" credit stays in frame in the street shots and must stay in any recut. The audio is a silent stereo track (ffmpeg anullsrc). Captions were written for this cut.
media.license: The project's own runtime capture. Jevica's in-game appearance, the IPIC lounge's floral wall (a texture from venue photo IMG_9761.jpg) and lettering, and the visible signage are shown with Val Alexander's approval (2026-10-15). Street geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; the credit stays in frame.
media.approval: Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-15 (#365): candidate 1 as cut, including the items listed under approvedItems.
approvedItems: Lounge shot (about 34–39 s): the floral wall is a texture cut from venue photo IMG_9761.jpg (preview/src/ipic-interior.js:232), and the repeated "I'm Busy for the rest of my Life." wall text reproduces the venue's own lettering (ipic-interior.js:162). A supplied venue photo is not blanket permission for its artwork (#365), so clear these or recut the shot.

Reception and return shots: real marks on the signage ("RIVER OAKS DISTRICT", "IPIC & THE TUCK ROOM") and photographed street frontages. The game already shows them in place; showing them in public media is a separate decision.
Jevica's in-game appearance in public media (Val).
transcript: Then out, to meet a friend at IPIC.
